scope: SDK-owned Classic registration evidence and per-operation native/web admission checks, separate from current administrator authority.
boundaries: Private SDK facts retain actual Discord guild/channel, Telegram group/private chat and button actor evidence; strict stored origin is unchanged.
Registered-room is the admission path for messages inside Classic rooms. Creation allowlists are deliberately not imposed on them; no creator authority or membership API is inferred.
Registration removal/rebinding, source incarnation change, ordinary native access removal, web session loss and guest scope revocation refuse without a lifetime mutation.
A demoted member still admitted to ordinary work keeps normal contact; current privileged-operation checks remain separate.
Free-to-Restricted uses the current root-source administrator exception or hold without relabelling; pending tickets preserve their decision path and Restricted history never becomes Free.
